backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor file serving as a placeholder for backend logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three logo size increase tasks in Header (40px→64px), HeroSection (48px→80px), and Footer (32px→56px) components with test IDs and high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend source files including components, styles, and configuration files.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles defining OKLCH color system variables for light and dark modes with cybersecurity-themed color palette and base styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with Spanish language, SEO meta tags for BlueFire cybersecurity targeting Mexican PYMEs and maquiladoras, and root div for React mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component rendering the complete single-page website with Header, HeroSection, ServicesSection, MarketContextSection, TargetClientsSection, ReferralProgramSection, PilotProgramSection, ContactSection, and Footer.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact section component with Angel Medina's contact details (email, phone, location) and a Spanish-labeled contact form with frontend-only validation and success message display.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying BlueFire logo at 56px (w-14 h-14), company name, services list, contact information, copyright with dynamic year, and caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Fixed navigation header with BlueFire logo at 64px (w-16 h-16), company name, and smooth-scroll navigation buttons for Servicios, Programa Piloto, and Contacto sections.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero section with BlueFire logo at 80px (w-20 h-20) in badge, Spanish tagline, CTAs for evaluation and services, and key cybersecurity statistics for Mexico.
frontend/src/components/MarketContextSec: Displays cybersecurity threat statistics for Mexico with four stat cards, a bar chart showing most affected sectors (Finance, Health, Manufacturing), and an alert about SME security gaps.
frontend/src/components/PilotProgramSect: Presents a pilot program offering a 48-hour vulnerability scan with a four-step process, deliverables list, optional remediation/retainer services, and a call-to-action to contact.
frontend/src/components/ReferralProgramS: Describes a referral program with four benefit cards (15-30% commission, payment terms) and a three-step process explaining how partners can earn commissions by referring clients.
frontend/src/components/SectorChart.tsx: Renders an SVG pie chart from sector data with percentage-based segments, calculates an "Otros" category to reach 100%, and displays a color-coded legend below.
Showcases four cybersecurity services (Asset Registry, Vulnerability Assessment, Remediation, Network Segmentation) in a grid with icons, descriptions, necessity explanations, and benefit lists.
frontend/src/components/TargetClientsSec: Compares two client segments (SMEs vs. Maquiladoras) with their sales cycle characteristics and displays four target client types (local SMEs, manufacturing plants, supply chain providers, MSPs).
React component displaying a four-step cybersecurity workflow (Asset Registry, Vulnerability Assessment, Patching, Segmentation) with icons, stages, and an integrated workflow diagram image.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and manages an ICP backend actor using React Query, automatically recreating the actor when Internet Identity changes and invalidating dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with cybersecurity-themed color palette using OKLCH color space, defining light and dark mode variables for primary (blue/cyan), secondary (slate gray), accent, and chart colors.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending default theme with custom OKLCH colors, container settings, typography, animations (accordion), and cybersecurity-themed shadows including glow effects.
project_state.json: Project metadata defining a Spanish-language cybersecurity presentation website for BlueFire targeting Mexican PYMEs and manufacturing plants, with features for hero section, services, market context, and target clients.
